newsitem.title: UK: Canada Maritime deploys 1,000 teu ship on Med route.
newsitem.headline: Canada Maritime deploys 1,000 teu ship on Med route.

text.p: Canada Maritime said Tuesday it has deployed the 1,000 teu container ship Canmar Valour to replace two existing vessels on route B of its North America to Mediterranean service.

The 1979-built ship, recently acquired from Orient Overseas Container Line, is compatible with other Canmar ships on the route and will strengthen the service's schedule relaibility, the company said. It will replace the Canmar Spirit and Canmar Venture.
The Canmar Valour will enter drydock in October for an overhaul which will include new radar equipment and paint protection from the effects of sailing through ice.

Canada Maritime is part of CP Ships, the container shipping interest of Canadian Pacific Ltd, which is in the process of acquiring US container shipping line Lykes Bros Steamship Co for $34 million. - Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
